entries.title: I Kings 12:1
segments: And Rehoboam went to Shechem. For all Israel had come to Shechem to make him king.

entries.title: I Kings 12:2
segments: And it happened when Jeroboam the son of Nebat, heard, he being still in Egypt; for he had fled from the presence of king Solomon, and Jeroboam lived in Egypt;

entries.title: I Kings 12:3
segments: they sent and called him. And Jeroboam and all the congregation of Israel came and spoke to Rehoboam, saying,

entries.title: I Kings 12:4
segments: Your father made our yoke hard. And now lighten the hard service of your father, and the heavy yoke which he put on us, and we will serve you.

entries.title: I Kings 12:5
segments: And he said to them, Go; yet in three days come back to me. And the people went away.

entries.title: I Kings 12:6
segments: And king Rehoboam talked with the old men who had stood before Solomon his father while he still lived, and said, How do you advise to return a word to this people?

entries.title: I Kings 12:7
segments: And they spoke to him, saying, If you will be a servant to this people today, and will serve them and answer them, and speak good words to them, then they will be your servants forever.

entries.title: I Kings 12:8
segments: But he left the counsel of the old men which they had advised him, and talked with the young men who had grown up with him, who stood before him.

entries.title: I Kings 12:9
segments: And he said to them, What advice do you give that we may answer this people who have spoken to me, saying, Lighten the yoke which your father put on us?

entries.title: I Kings 12:10
segments: And the young men who had grown up with him spoke to him, saying, So shall you speak to this people who spoke to you, saying, Your father made our yoke heavy, but you make [it] lighter for us, so you shall say to them: My little finger shall be thicker than my father's loins.

entries.title: I Kings 12:11
segments: And now my father loaded you with a heavy yoke, and I will add to your yoke. My father has whipped you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.

entries.title: I Kings 12:12
segments: And they came, Jeroboam and all the people, to Rehoboam the third day, as the king had appointed, saying, Come to me again the third day.

entries.title: I Kings 12:13
segments: And the king answered the people roughly, and left the old men's advice which they advised him,

entries.title: I Kings 12:14
segments: and spoke to them according to the advice of the young men, saying, My father made your yoke heavy, and I will add to your yoke. My father whipped you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.

entries.title: I Kings 12:15
segments: And the king did not listen to the people, for the cause was from the LORD, that He might perform His saying which the LORD spoke by Ahijah of Shiloh to Jeroboam the son of Nebat.

entries.title: I Kings 12:16
segments: And all Israel saw that the king did not listen to them, and the people answered the king, saying, What part do we have in David? Yea, [there is] no inheritance in the son of Jesse. To your tents, O Israel! Now see to your house, O David! And Israel went to its tents.

entries.title: I Kings 12:17
segments: [As for] the sons of Israel, those living in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.

entries.title: I Kings 12:18
segments: And king Rehoboam sent Adoram, who [was] over the tribute. And all Israel stoned him with stones so that he died. And king Rehoboam made haste to go up to get into a chariot to flee to Jerusalem.

entries.title: I Kings 12:19
segments: And Israel rebelled against the house of David to this day.

entries.title: I Kings 12:20
segments: And it happened when all Israel heard that Jeroboam had come again, they sent and called him to the company, and made him king over all Israel. There was none who followed the house of David, but the tribe of Judah only.

entries.title: I Kings 12:21
segments: And when Rehoboam came to Jerusalem, and he gathered all the house of Judah with the tribe of Benjamin, a hundred and eighty thousand warriors, to fight against the house of Israel, to bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam the son of Solomon.

entries.title: I Kings 12:22
segments: But the word of God came to Shemaiah the man of God, saying,

entries.title: I Kings 12:23
segments: Speak to Rehoboam the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to all the house of Judah and Benjamin, and to the rest of the people, saying,

entries.title: I Kings 12:24
segments: So says the LORD, You shall not go up, nor fight against your brothers the sons of Israel. Each man return to his house. For this thing is from Me. And they listened to the word of the LORD and turned to go back, according to the word of the LORD.

entries.title: I Kings 12:25
segments: And Jeroboam built Shechem in mount Ephraim and lived in it, and went out from there and built Penuel.

entries.title: I Kings 12:26
segments: And Jeroboam said in his heart, Now the kingdom shall return to the house of David!

entries.title: I Kings 12:27
segments: If this people go up to do sacrifice in the house of the LORD at Jerusalem, then shall the heart of this people turn again to their lord, to Rehoboam king of Judah, and they shall kill me and go again to Rehoboam king of Judah.

entries.title: I Kings 12:28
segments: And the king took counsel, and made two calves [of] gold and said to them, It is too much for you to go up to Jerusalem. Behold your gods, O, Israel, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt!

entries.title: I Kings 12:29
segments: And he set the one in Bethel, and he put the other in Dan.

entries.title: I Kings 12:30
segments: And this thing became a sin, for the people went to worship before the one, even to Dan.

entries.title: I Kings 12:31
segments: And he made a house of high places, and made priests of the lowest of the people, who were not the sons of Levi.

entries.title: I Kings 12:32
segments: And Jeroboam ordered a feast in the eighth month, on the fifteenth day of the month, like the feast that [is] in Judah. And he offered on the altar. So he did in Bethel, sacrificing to the calves that he had made. And he placed in Bethel the priests of the high places which he had made.

entries.title: I Kings 12:33
segments: And he offered on the altar which he had made in Bethel the fifteenth day of the eighth month, in the month which he had devised out of his own heart. And he ordered a feast for the sons of Israel. And he offered on the altar, and burned incense.
